name: Account Contract
definition: Agreement between an account servicer and an account owner about the services linked to an account.

TargetClosingDate.name: Target Closing Date
TargetClosingDate.definition: Date on which the account and related services are expected to cease to be operational for the account owner.

UrgencyFlag.name: Urgency Flag
UrgencyFlag.definition: Indicator that the change to the contract needs to be treated urgently.

RemovalIndicator.name: Removal Indicator
RemovalIndicator.definition: Indicates removal of the account. After removal, an account will not appear anymore in reports.

TargetGoLiveDate.name: Target Go Live Date
TargetGoLiveDate.definition: Date on which the account and related services are expected to cease/to be operational for the account owner.

TransactionChannel.name: Transaction Channel
TransactionChannel.definition: Specifies the means by which the account owner submits the open account form.

AccountService.name: Account Service
AccountService.definition: Operations on a bank account that are allowed as part of the services offered to the owners of a bank account,

Account.name: Account
Account.definition: Specifies the account which is managed by a contract.

Interest.name: Interest
Interest.definition: Interest that applies to the account.

AccountAuthorisation.name: Account Authorisation
AccountAuthorisation.definition: Specifies the services which are assigned to another party.
